The tumor has no necrosis, no non-contrast enhancing necrotic component, only a very small enhancing volume, mild enhancement, no midline crossing, no ependymal invasion, no deep white matter invasion, and no tumor-associated ventricular asymmetry; these findings argue against grade 4 and are more compatible with a lower-grade diffuse glioma.
